text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's state-owned Grain Marketing Board will continue to set its producer and selling prices in line with market forces to meet the requirements of its commercial activities and the national strategic grain reserve, lands and agriculture minister Kumbirai Kangai said on Monday.
- Eleven people have died in Zimbabwean road accidents in the last six days, making the run-up to the national Heroes Day holiday one of the worst in recent years.
